title: WebGPU Cubemaps in Rust: Skyboxes and Reflections
description: Render a skybox and reflective sphere with Rust, wgpu, and WGSL. Learn cubemap face order, KTX texture loading, cube views, depth settings, and environment mapping.
imageAlt: A reflective sphere mirrors a suspension bridge, river, and blue evening sky, surrounded by the same cubemap skybox.
